title: Pauli spectrum and nonstabilizerness of random fermionic Gaussian states
summary: We characterize the magic of random fermionic Gaussian states through their Pauli spectrum and their stabilizer entropies. For the Haar ensemble of Majorana Gaussian states we derive closed finite-$N$ expressions for the average stabilizer purities and reconstruct the Pauli spectrum exactly, as a mixture of products of beta-distributed variables resolved by Majorana weight. The stabilizer entropies, and their filtered versions, freeze at Rényi index $q_c=2$: for $q>2$ the magic density is $1/(q-1)$, controlled by rare weight-two Majorana strings.
